$schema_note: THETA runtime-branch-shaped strategy registry (R6F, THETA_STRATEGY_ENGINE_AND_IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC_v1.0 section 3/13-17). Distinct from strategy_archetypes.json, which organizes CROSS-CUTTING RESEARCH programmes (THETA-Q/H/R/C/A/D) explicitly disclaimed there as NOT the runtime branch enum. This file's 5 records match the frozen Backend Schema section 7 strategy_branch enum exactly: THETA_CONVENTIONAL / THETA_HOLD_STRIKE / THETA_RECOVERY / THETA_CC / THETA_DEFINED_RISK. Every field below is a research-side description, never a Production activation -- Codex owns Production strategy_version rows.

branches.purpose: Primary quality-underlying cash-secured put / covered-call cycle. Edge hypothesis: selective short-premium entry on ownership-acceptable underlyings, combined with intentional assignment handling and dynamic management, produces positive complete-cycle after-cost expectancy.
optional_evidence: expert priors (Orange Cat, Hendo_67, Ivan Orehovec)
unresolved_assumptions: 30-60 DTE / 0.20-0.25 delta default is a BASELINE, not proven optimal (spec section 33)

branches.purpose: Short-DTE (2-5), ATM/near-ATM, assignment-aware challenger derived from IWM Hold-the-Strike behavioral evidence. Never blended into THETA_CONVENTIONAL or generalized to new underlyings without evidence.
optional_evidence: expert priors (IWM Hold the Strike -- OBSERVED; SQQQ Hold the Strike -- failure-DNA control)
hard_constraints: underlying explicitly in the separately-validated cohort list
branches.management_policy_family: research/strategies/theta -- same families as THETA_CONVENTIONAL, evaluated on this branch's own independent sample
supporting_evidence: hypotheses.json: H-H-01 (READY_TO_TEST, HIGH SCRUTINY), H-H-02 (RETAIN, measurement)
contradictory_evidence: SQQQ Hold the Strike: very high closed-trade WR coexisting with large portfolio drawdown -- a documented failure-DNA control, not evidence against this branch generically
unresolved_assumptions: No universal transfer to a new underlying is permitted without its own separate OOS/tail/recovery evidence

branches.purpose: Assigned-stock management: an explicit comparison of RECOVERY_WAIT vs SELL_STOCK vs SELL_CC under the current economic/regime state -- never passive holding by default.
optional_evidence: expert priors (Orange Cat patience lesson, Wheeling to Freedom active-management lesson)
branches.management_policy_family: action_value_distribution.py -- outcome distribution per action, not a fixed recovery-day count
unresolved_assumptions: Recovery-time distribution model is SPECIFIED (recovery_spec.py) but not empirically fit

branches.purpose: Owned-share monetization: searches a strike/expiration frontier and compares SELL_CC/HOLD_CC/CLOSE_CC/ROLL_CC/ALLOW_CALL_AWAY -- never automatically sells the highest-yield call after assignment.
branches.management_policy_family: CCUtility = EV_premium + EV_stock - CallAwayRegret - EventRiskPenalty - ExecutionCost - TailPenalty
unresolved_assumptions: Call-away probability is empirically UNKNOWN until calibrated -- never a fabricated delta-derived number

branches.purpose: Bounded-risk premium alternative (put credit spread initially) for when full CSP collateral would make quantity zero, or when tail economics are materially better bounded.
optional_evidence: expert priors (Ivan Orehovec small-account, Lick Neeson structure-routing -- both INFERRED/hypothesis-only)

candidate_lattice.other_structures: require a separate versioned strategy family

unresolved_assumptions: Not an automatic fallback for qty=0 -- must independently beat WAIT and THETA_CONVENTIONAL on after-cost utility inside the approved risk budget
